name: What is the process for purchasing a tiny home shell?
description: Purchasing a tiny home shell involves consultation, proposal, deposit, construction, updates, final inspection, and delivery.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for purchasing a tiny home shell?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, design preferences, and budget. Next, we develop a custom proposal outlining the shell's specifications and cost. Upon agreement, a deposit secures your build slot. We then proceed with construction of your shell. Throughout the build, we maintain communication, providing updates on progress. Once completed, a final inspection and payment are conducted, followed by delivery or pick-up of your new tiny home shell.
acceptedAnswer.description: Purchasing a tiny home shell involves consultation, proposal, deposit, construction, updates, final inspection, and delivery.
